summary: Preserve that the same textual private name declared in a subclass is a distinct private name from the one in its superclass.

target.notes: Emit separate private fields in each generated C# type. Same textual C# field names may be used because private members occupy separate declaring types.

semantics.inherited_access: subclass cannot access superclass private name unless exposed by superclass code

caveats: Parser/early-error handling must reject undeclared private names before lowering.

tests.name: distinct private slots
tests.input: class B { #x=1; getB(){return this.#x;} } class D extends B { #x=2; getD(){return this.#x;} } const d=new D(); console.log(d.getB(),d.getD());
tests.expected_csharp: class B { private double _x=1; } class D:B { private double _x=2; }

tests.name: edge: subclass source cannot name base private slot
tests.input: class B { #x=1; } class D extends B { m(){ return this.#x; } }
tests.expected_behavior: early SyntaxError because #x is not declared in D
